extension.summary: Watch F1 live streams in Kodi (Android build)
extension.description: LIVE F1/motorsport streams from daddylive (race, qualifying, practice as they happen) — Android-flavoured build: pure-Python stdlib only, no bundled Windows binaries, replays omitted (source blocks non-browser clients on mobile). Race replays: install the PC build on Windows Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This addon scrapes publicly available streaming links. The author does not host or stream any content. For educational use only.
extension.s: Android track — stdlib-only live build. PC-history changelog lives in the PC addon's manifest.
extension.news: v2.8.12 - DIAG2: "Server nexa unreachable" toasts now include the real reason (DNS fail / timeout / SSL error) from f1_servers.http_error() — phone-side cause is visible without a log. v2.8.11 - DIAG: on a failed resolve, the toast now shows the exact failing STEP (STEP1 watch.php / STEP2 stream page / STEP3 embed hosts / STEP4 edge manifest) so phone-side failures are self-reported. Resolve retries once after 2s. Wider embed fallbacks: +dembed.st (observed live 2026-11-02), +bembed.sbs. v2.8.10 - ANDROID TRACK: first platform-split release. Live lanes only (dlive.sx + vertex/nexa/kora numbered servers) — replays omitted, that upstream blocks non-browser clients. Same live resolver as PC track; updates ride their own version line so PC-side changes can't break the phone. (PC track continues at plugin.video.f1streams.)
